description: Daily working records (勤務実績): day category (労働日 / 所定休日 / 法定休日), start/end, punch times. staffIds is optional and defaults to yourself (omit it for the signed-in person; the response then has no staffId, same as before). Admins may pass staff they manage (from list_staff), up to 50 per request. When the API returns net minutes, actualWorkingMinutes is that value. When it does not, actualWorkingMinutes stays the elapsed start-to-end and estimatedNetMinutes subtracts known breaks or, if breaks are missing, the statutory minimum (over 6h → 45 min, over 8h → 60 min). That second figure is an estimate (estimateNote). Defaults: the 1st of this month through today (Japan time, YYYY-MM-DD). Split into 31-day requests (max 366 days). No overtime field — summarize_working_hours for your totals, close_out for what you should fix, team_close_out for the team. Do not call this once per person to close a team.

from.description: Start date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to the 1st of this month.

staffIds.description: Staff IDs to include. Omit for yourself only. Admins: IDs from list_staff. Unknown IDs are rejected when the staff list is complete.

to.description: End date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today.

name: get_working_records
title: Get my working records
